title: Moscow Under Siege
subtitle: Emergency defense measures and the continuing crisis around Moscow.
author: R.G. Cruise
summary: Moscow’s emergency decree and the Soviet defence are set against the German army’s worsening transport and supply position.
outlineTopics: The continuing German attempt to advance toward Moscow.
Soviet defensive positions after the loss of the western formations.
The State Defense Committee's October 19 emergency decree.
The declaration of a state of siege effective October 20.
Soviet measures to maintain public order.
Military command and civilian administration in the capital.
Reinforcements and reserve formations defending the Moscow region.
Soviet efforts to maintain transportation and supply.
The effects of mud, damaged roads, fuel shortages, and mechanical attrition.
The status of German armored forces.
Continued fighting around Mozhaisk and neighboring defensive sectors.
Developments on the northern and southern approaches to Moscow.
The wider political significance of defending the Soviet capital.
researchStatus: Research brief. Full study and dated military reconstruction in preparation.
